  "rationales": {
    "LC": "The delivered payload is a user message containing document markers, and its language directly determines the outbound destination; there is no actual knowledge-base ingestion step. Phrase matching and HTTP URL parsing do not reduce the destination to closed, independently authorized fields (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:32-57, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271).",
    "CP": "RAGBot's knowledge base is static, and this path reads the latest user message without storing injected instructions or modifying standing behavior. Consequently, this is stateless influence rather than persistent RAG poisoning (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:301-332, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271).",
    "AP": "Influence passes from the message detector into the submit_to_index tool function within the same agent process and policy domain. The outbound request discloses data but does not establish propagation of compromised authority into another agent or principal (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:293-319).",
    "RH": "The path reaches a success-accounting proxy: it marks the attack successful and updates category accounting before obtaining the outbound request's result. No human-verified reward-hacking episode is reported; the documented canary demonstration verifies disclosure, not manipulation of that proxy (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:216-259).",
    "ES": "The reachable extension is submit_to_index, whose destination host is attacker-controlled and lacks an independent destination allowlist or least-privilege authorization on vulnerable RAGBot. Restricting the scheme to HTTP(S) and fixing the request method does not constrain the security-relevant destination sufficiently (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:59-75, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:293-319).",
    "CVSS": "Default loopback binding makes the delivered attack local; the agent endpoint is unauthenticated, and the demo sender can deliver the deterministic payload without another human, secret, race, or nondefault configuration (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:59-75). The entire mock knowledge base, including its planted admin password and SSN, is disclosed, supporting VC:H; no protected-data modification or availability loss is established (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:301-332, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271). The demo operator controls the receiving canary, so receipt there is not confidentiality, integrity, or availability damage to a separate victim system (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:216-259)."
  },

  "rh_facts": {

  "automatable": "Yes",
  "automatable_rationale": "For a sender able to reach the default local endpoint, payload construction, delivery, URL extraction, and disclosure are deterministic and require no human approval or model-dependent outcome. This does not imply that the default listener is remotely exposed (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:59-75, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26).",
  "technical_impact": "Partial",
  "technical_impact_rationale": "The path discloses the complete mock knowledge base, but does not establish arbitrary process control, modification of protected state, access to the fleet's other tool handlers, or sustained service disruption. Its demonstrated effect is a bounded confidentiality compromise (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:293-319).",
  "applicability_as_implemented": {
    "model_directed_goal_pursuit": false,
    "selects_or_sequences_actions": false,
    "confidence": "high",
    "rationale": "The default deployment uses simulated responses, and this attack follows a fixed detector-to-HTTP-request sequence without an LLM key. Code, rather than a model pursuing a goal, selects the tool and constructs its arguments (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:60, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:59-75, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271)."
  },
  "applicability_as_modeled": {
    "model_directed_goal_pursuit": true,
    "selects_or_sequences_actions": true,
    "confidence": "medium",
    "rationale": "The documented scenario models a retrieval agent pursuing a retrieve-and-summarize goal, then being redirected by document instructions into an outbound tool action. That agentic account differs from the deterministic implementation and does not establish broader autonomous planning (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:301-332, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:12-57, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:216-259)."
